source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 疑锋逼近，暗线将明
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC24 after EP02 SC23 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the crowd's questioning aftermath into the next tightening turn: Keshadu presses his suspicion more directly, Shisilang remains humiliated and volatile, Tuobaye is trapped under scrutiny, and the white-clothed woman's restraint becomes even more dangerous as the hidden-helper line nears exposure.
title: 疑锋逼近，暗线将明

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC23 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC23 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing. SH02 required storyboard regeneration before pass.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 众惊追问，十四郎羞怒，科沙度越发怀疑白衣女子暗中相助。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 接下来局势会从群体惊疑进一步收束成更直接的试探与盘问。科沙度的怀疑将更锋利，十四郎的受辱会推动他继续纠缠，拓拔野则在完全不明底牌的状态下被推到更危险的位置。白衣女子越是克制沉静，越显得像即将出手的暗雷。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段要把怀疑从气氛变成更明确的压迫动作，为白衣女子与科沙度之间的暗线对撞继续蓄势。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant, restrained, and dangerous; no overt spell spectacle.
Keshadu must continue to read as the sharpest and coldest observer in the scene.
Shisilang remains humiliated and volatile, not restored to calm dominance.
The white dragon-deer may remain present but should not hijack a suspicion-and-pressure beat.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: direct suspicion, social pressure, volatile pride, and hidden restraint should appear as separate visual steps.
